name: Fleshwarping (Item Creation)
body:
You can create creatures through an abominable alchemical process.

Prerequisite(s): Craft (alchemy) 5 ranks, Heal 5 ranks, evil alignment.

Benefit(s): You can create fleshwarped creatures and fleshcraft grafts and elixirs (see below). A newly created fleshwarped creature has average hit points for its Hit Dice.
